issues.issue: Did the Officer err in law by assessing the spousal sponsorship under H&C guidelines (OB 544) instead of the sponsorship guidelines?
issues.applicant_position: Officer should have applied OB 633 or IP 8, not OB 544; misreading the guidelines is an error of law.
issues.respondent_position: Guidelines are not binding; sponsorship and H&C applications are separate, and OB 544 was properly applied given the H&C request.
issues.result_quote: the Officer did not commit an error of law by reading OB 544, rather, than OB 633.

issues.issue: Did the Officer show a lack of diligence and breach the applicant's legitimate expectations by not telling him to cancel his 2008 H&C application?
issues.applicant_position: Officer lacked diligence and frustrated legitimate expectations by not telling him to cancel the earlier H&C application.
issues.respondent_position: No duty to inform; the sponsorship was processed diligently and no legitimate expectation arose.
issues.result_quote: There was no legitimate expectation in this case that the Officer would contact the Applicant in order to give him the opportunity to cancel his pending H&C application.
